planned_anchors.what_is_missing: QymCAD threads &mut self.project and &mut self.status through one doorway, so a command always reads the live project. OM9 keeps the single doorway but must also be able to say WHICH document and view a run started against, because OM9 can replace the document while a command is alive. QymCAD has no such snapshot.

planned_anchors.what_is_missing: No document/view identity and no notion of a stale interface state.
Interface state per command; not session identity.

implemented_api_before_this_task: session.rs::CommandSession { feature, epoch: u64, context: u64, plane, unit, start, both_sides } — the session recorded the document's context_revision and the coordinator epoch, but NOT which view it started in and not the typed selection
session.rs::validate_session compared the epoch and context_revision only
session.rs::is_running() was self.session.is_some(), so a command whose document or view was gone still counted as running
gap_found_by_this_task: The active view was not part of the context: a command started in view A went on asking for points after the user switched to view B, and the second point was accepted (fixture K1/K2, test c2/c3 failed before the fix).
Context loss did not cancel anything: is_running() stayed true and the prompt kept asking, so closing or replacing the active document left a command that could only fail later (fixture K1/K4).

Added: CommandContext { document, view, selection, revision, epoch }, Controller::context(), validate_context (Stale on any of the four), is_running()/phase()/prompt() treating a stale session as Idle, and cancel_if_stale() so a caller can drop it and report the cancellation.

CORRECTION (same day): the view rule was too strong at first. The pre-existing tests/chrome_actions.rs cases (a view-tab switch must keep a running command and its numeric draft) showed that switching the ACTIVE view is not losing the context. validate_context now refuses when the document identity changes, when the view the run started in is gone, or when the revision/epoch moved; a view-tab switch keeps the run with the view and plane it captured. Fixtures and tests were corrected with it.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the single doorway of gui.rs; ADD the document/view snapshot, its validation and the cancellation on context loss.
